Mathematical Specification
Let the sequence \(a = [a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{n-1}]\) be a vector of nonnegative real numbers. The autocorrelation \(c\) is defined by:
\[
c[k] = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1-k} a_i a_{k+i} \quad \text{(or zero if k+i is outside the valid range)}
\]

\[
